bg.$description: Fill of the AI provenance mark.

fg.$description: Text and icon ink of the AI provenance mark.

bg-image.$description: Optional image over the AI provenance fill. Defaults to none.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete filter behind the AI provenance mark. Defaults to none.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the AI provenance mark.

gap.$description: Gap between the mark and its icon or between provenance metadata items.

border-width.$description: Border width of the panel and the forced-colors mark.

height.$description: Minimum painted block size of the small AI mark.

padding-inline.$description: Inline inset of the small AI mark.

icon-size.$description: Sparkles icon size in the small AI mark.

height.$description: Minimum painted block size of the medium AI mark.

padding-inline.$description: Inline inset of the medium AI mark.

icon-size.$description: Sparkles icon size in the medium AI mark.

bg.$description: Raised fill of the provenance explanation.

fg.$description: Ink of the provenance explanation and metadata.

bg-image.$description: Optional image over the provenance explanation fill. Defaults to none.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete filter behind the provenance explanation. Defaults to none.

border.$description: Hairline color of the explanation panel.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the explanation panel.

width.$description: Preferred inline size of the explanation panel.

gap.$description: Gap between the panel sections and between the panel and trigger.
